书童 Pagekin

原名「AI 小说作家 / AI Novel Writer」

Pagekin，免费 AI 小说写作软件
从设定、架构、章节蓝图到正文、审稿、修稿、定稿，一章一章把书写完；也能拆解参考小说来仿写、导入原稿接着续写，或按你的要求改写。
本地优先：作品存在你自己的电脑上。软件不带模型：接你自己的 API Key，或用 Ollama 跑本地模型。

书童 Pagekin 由 EthanYoQ 维护。[官方主页](https://www.orz.md/ai-novel-writer/)提供产品介绍、使用指南和正式下载入口。


观看 32 秒中文实录：选段续写与改成对话
1.3.0 实录，模型等待段已剪短，AI 配音；32 秒是片长，不是生成耗时。

## 它能做什么 书童按写一本小说的顺序工作：你是作者，它是书童。每一步的结果都存进作品，下一步接着用。AI 负责起草，每一步由你确认。 ### 书房：管理你的全部作品 书房列出你写过的每一部作品。点封面可以先看概览：写到第几步、正文字数、定稿章数、角色数。可以新建作品，也可以把旧版本的项目导入成一份副本。 ![书房：书架上有两部作品，右侧是《灯塔》的概览和进度](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-library.webp) ### 拆解、仿写、续写与改写 书房里的「小说拆解与仿写」可以导入一部 .txt、.md 或 .epub 小说，按章拆开，导入时选择用途。 - **拆解与仿写**：选「参考小说」，AI 拆解它的结构、提取文风、反推章节蓝图，生成仿写约束，供你后面写作时参考。参考小说只进知识库和拆解结果，不会混进你的正文。 - **导入原稿续写**：选「我的原稿」，你已经写好的章节按章节号导入为定稿，AI 续写后面的章节时会接着前文的人物和情节走。 - **段落续写**：正文里选中一段文字，点工具条上的「续写」，AI 接着这段往下写。 - **改写**：整章改写用「修稿」，写下你要改的方向，也可以勾选审稿意见，修稿结果按段落和原稿对比，由你逐段决定用哪一版。改一小段时，选中文字后用工具条上的润色、扩写或改成对话。 ### 设定与架构：先把故事立起来 设定页写下类型、受众、写作语言、总章数和每章字数。架构页分四节：故事前提、角色名单、世界观、情节大纲。每一节都可以让 AI 生成，也可以自己写。四节都确认后，再进入章节蓝图。 ![架构页：故事前提、角色名单、世界观、情节大纲四节都已确认](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-architecture.webp) 角色名单和架构放在一起编辑。每个角色有基础设定、当前状态和关系图谱。角色卡可以粘贴或从文件导入。 ![角色名单：左侧列出四个角色，右侧是主角林岚的档案](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-cast.webp) ### 章节蓝图：动笔前先想清楚每一章 蓝图页逐章列出规划。每章写清主角小目标、冲突与转折、悬念钩子和出场人物。蓝图可以由 AI 按章节范围分批生成，中断后可以接着生成。 主按钮是「写第 N 章」。旁边的小弹层只放这一次写作的选项：用哪个模型，要不要补一句作者指导。想连写几章，用「批量创作」，一次最多 10 章。 ![蓝图页：选中第 3 章「雾钟」，「写第 3 章」的写作选项弹层已打开](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-blueprint.webp) ### 正文：写稿、审稿、修稿、定稿 正文单章视图把一章从待写带到定稿。AI 写出草稿后，你可以直接改，也可以让 AI 审稿。审稿报告列出每条意见，你逐条勾选或忽略，也可以加上自己的意见。修稿结果以差异给你逐段确认，不会直接覆盖原稿。确认无误后定稿。 ![正文单章视图：左侧是设定、架构、蓝图、正文四步流程，中间是第 3 章正文，右侧是审稿报告](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-chapter.webp) 写作时，AI 拿到的是这一章的蓝图、相关角色、世界观、前文摘要和上一章全文，而不是整本书的聊天记录。 正文编辑器支持 Tab 插入两个全角空格作为段首缩进。写一章的全过程可以只用键盘完成。 ### 运行侧页：看清 AI 正在做什么 所有生成任务都在运行侧页里，分进行中、历史、诊断三页。写作时可以实时看到输出，随时取消。批量创作可以暂停。生成失败时，已经写出的文字会留成恢复候选，可以复制或放弃。 ![运行侧页：正在写第 3 章，实时输出逐句出现](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-run.webp) ### 作品资料与版本：写长篇不丢线索 - **剧情与伏笔**：按章节看主线、支线和伏笔的进度，记下每条线索在哪一章埋设、推进或解决。 - **知识库**：导入参考资料（.txt、.md）。没有配置检索模型时，也能用本地全文检索。 - **版本历史**：每章的历次稿件都留着，可以和当前稿对比，也可以回退成一份新草稿。 - **导出与备份**：导出为合并 Markdown、分章 Markdown 或 TXT。可以把作品打包存到本机，或备份到你绑定的 WebDAV 云端。恢复时总是另存为一份新副本。 ### 写作 Skill：导入你自己的写作规则 在设置的「写作 Skills」页，可以从本机选一个 Skill 文件夹或单个 SKILL.md，也可以填 GitHub 上的 Skill 地址，导入提示词型的写作 Skill，比如「去 AI 味」、某种文风或某类题材的写法。SKILL.md 引用的 references 文本会一并装入。安装前软件会先读取并展示内容，由你检查后再安装。装好后把它绑定到规划、写稿、审稿或修稿阶段，之后这一阶段的生成都会带上它。 只支持自包含的 SKILL.md 提示词。脚本、hook、子代理和工具调用这类内容不会被安装，Skill 不能在你的电脑上执行代码。 ### 深色主题与中英文界面 外观有浅色和深色两套。界面支持中文和英文。作品的写作语言可以选中文或英文。 ![深色主题下的正文单章视图](docs/assets/readme/v130-zh-chapter-dark.webp) ## 支持的模型与服务 书童不提供模型，也不代管额度。你在设置里填上自己的服务地址、模型名和 API Key。软件支持两种调用协议： - **OpenAI 兼容协议**：Chat Completions 接口兼容的服务都可以用。 - **Gemini 原生协议**：Google Gemini。 设置里内置了这些服务商的预设： | 服务商 | 协议 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | DeepSeek | OpenAI 兼容 | 预设地址 `https://api.deepseek.com` | | SiliconFlow（硅基流动） | OpenAI 兼容 | 预设地址 `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` | | BigModel（智谱） | OpenAI 兼容 | 预设地址 `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4` | | OpenAI | OpenAI 兼容 | 预设地址 `https://api.openai.com` | | xAI（Grok） | OpenAI 兼容 | 预设地址 `https://api.x.ai/v1` | | Google Gemini | Gemini 原生 | 预设地址 `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` | | Ollama（本地） | OpenAI 兼容 | 模型跑在你自己的电脑上 | | NovelAI | OpenAI 兼容 | 最小兼容支持，未用真实账号完整验证 | | 自定义 | OpenAI 兼容 | 填任意兼容服务的地址 | 「自定义」只是在上面两种协议里换地址、模型名和凭据，不是任意 HTTP 接口。Anthropic、Azure、KoboldAI 原生接口等需要单独的适配器，换个 URL 不能保证能用。 知识库的语义检索另需一个向量模型，在设置的「检索模型」里配置。 ### 用 Ollama 跑本地模型 ```text 服务商： Ollama（本地）或自定义 协议： OpenAI 兼容 Base URL： http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 API Key： 可以留空；界面要求时填任意占位值 模型： 你的 Ollama 模型名，例如 qwen3:14b ``` 向量模型也用 `/v1` 地址。不要填 `http://127.0.0.1:11434/api`，那是 Ollama 的原生接口。 ## 下载与安装 请只从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/Pagekin/releases/latest) 下载正式安装包。 ### Windows x64 ```text ai-novel-writer-setup-<版本号>.exe ``` 1. 运行安装程序。升级时安装程序只更新应用本身，不会删除作品、角色卡或设置。重要作品仍建议先备份。 2. 安装后，应用可以在「设置 → 关于与更新」里检查更新。发现新版本时先提示你，你点「下载更新」后才开始下载，下载完再选择立即重启更新或稍后。 3. 旧版便携 ZIP 不能自动获得更新器，需要手动安装一次正式安装包。 当前安装程序未进行代码签名。Windows 可能提示未知发布者。请确认下载页面是本项目的官方 GitHub Release 后再继续。 ### macOS（Apple Silicon 与 Intel） ```text ai-novel-writer-mac-arm64-<版本号>-installer.dmg ai-novel-writer-mac-x64-<版本号>-installer.dmg ``` 1. `arm64` 适用于 Apple Silicon Mac（M1、M2、M3、M4 等）。`x64` 适用于 Intel Mac。 2. 把 DMG 里的应用拖进「应用程序」文件夹后启动。应用会提示新版本，但不会在 macOS 上自动下载或替换程序。更新时打开官方 Release 页面，手动下载对应架构的安装包。 3. 两个安装包均为 ad-hoc 签名，且均未使用 Developer ID 签名或公证。Gatekeeper 阻止打开时，先确认来源是本项目的官方 GitHub Release，再在 Finder 里按住 Control 点按应用并选择「打开」，或在「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性」里允许打开。 ## 数据与隐私 | 数据或行为 | 存放位置或去向 | | --- | --- | | 作品、角色、蓝图、草稿和定稿 | 你的作品文件夹和本地 SQLite 数据库。 | | 生成失败的恢复候选 | 只存在当前作品的本地数据库里，不会自动变成草稿或定稿。 | | 导入的参考资料 | 留在本地作品里，除非你把它发给云端模型。 | | 本地模型请求 | 发给你配置的本机或局域网推理服务。 | | 云端模型请求 | 提示词和上下文发给你选择的服务商。 | | 模型配置与 API Key | 保存在本机应用数据目录的 `ai-novel-writer` 文件夹里（Windows 为 `%APPDATA%\ai-novel-writer`，macOS 为 `~/Library/Application Support/ai-novel-writer`）。请保护好系统账户，不要分享这个文件夹。 | | 应用偏好 | 与模型配置在同一个文件夹里。 | 早期版本把配置存在 `~/.vela`。新版本启动时会把它复制到上面的文件夹，原目录不改动。 软件本身不提供模型账号、云端生成服务或运营消息推送。联网检查更新只读取公开的 GitHub Release。 ## 常见问题 **书童免费吗？** 免费。软件以 GPL-3.0 协议开源。调用云端模型产生的费用由你和模型服务商结算，与本软件无关。用 Ollama 跑本地模型则不需要付费给任何服务商。 **需要什么模型？** 任何兼容 OpenAI Chat Completions 接口的模型都可以接，Google Gemini 走原生协议。设置里有 DeepSeek、SiliconFlow、智谱、OpenAI、xAI、Gemini、Ollama 和 NovelAI 的预设。生成质量取决于你选的模型，软件不对模型输出质量作保证。 **作品数据存在哪里？** 存在你自己的电脑上：作品文件夹加一个本地 SQLite 数据库。只有你发起生成时，相关的提示词、作品设定和上下文才会发给你配置的模型服务。 **能写多长的小说？** 总章数由你在设定里填，没有固定上限。写每一章时，AI 拿到的是这一章的蓝图、相关角色、世界观、前文摘要和上一章全文，所以不需要把整本书塞进一次对话。批量创作一次最多连写 10 章，可以多次接着写。 **支持英文写作吗？** 支持。界面有中文和英文两种，作品的写作语言也可以选中文或英文。 **旧版本的项目怎么升级到 1.3.0？** 已经装了 1.1.0 或 1.2.x 的用户，可以直接用应用内更新升级（macOS 需要手动下载新安装包）。升级不改动作品数据，旧的外观偏好会自动迁移成浅色或深色。旧版本的项目如果要转成新格式，在书房点「导入」，选择「导入旧项目副本」。导入会生成一份新副本，原项目保持不动。 **能导入 Skill 吗？比如去 AI 味。** 可以。在设置的「写作 Skills」页选择本机的 Skill 文件夹或 SKILL.md，或填 GitHub 上的 Skill 地址，检查内容后安装，再绑定到写稿或修稿等阶段。只支持提示词型的 SKILL.md，不会安装或执行脚本。 **助手聊天去哪了？** 1.3.0 的新界面暂时隐藏了助手聊天入口，以后会单独重新开放。写作、审稿、修稿等功能不受影响。 **Windows 或 macOS 提示安装包不安全怎么办？** Windows 安装包未签名，Mac 安装包只有 ad-hoc 签名、没有经过 Apple 公证，所以系统会提示。确认安装包来自本项目的官方 GitHub Release 后，按上面「下载与安装」的步骤允许打开。 ## 当前限制 - 不保证任意第三方 API 只靠 URL 和 Key 就能接入，只保证已实现的协议和预设。 - 不替代作者的创意、事实核查和版权判断。AI 写出的内容需要你审阅。 - 不提供在线发布、阅读社区或云端模型账号。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Node.js 22.14 以上和仓库指定版本的 pnpm。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer.git cd AI-Novel-Writer pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev ``` 正式安装包由 GitHub Actions 云端构建。Windows x64、macOS Apple Silicon 和 macOS Intel 三个安装包各自通过资格检查后，才进入同一个 GitHub Release。文档权威层级、ADR 和开发规则见 [`docs/README.md`](docs/README.md)。Logo、配色和设计稿见[品牌包](docs/brand/README.md)。 ## 参与贡献 Bug 和功能建议请提交到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer/issues)，使用问题请发到 [Discussions](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer/discussions)。提交 Pull Request 前请先读 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。这是公开仓库，提交内容请先脱敏，不要上传 API Key、完整小说正文或本机路径。 ## DeepSeek Harness 插件（冻结维护） 仓库里还保留了 `@ethanyoq/dsh-ai-novel-writer` `0.1.0` 开发预览版，它是 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件。插件目前冻结维护，短期不扩展功能。它的能力不足桌面版的 10%，不读取桌面版项目，不能替代桌面版。插件以 MIT 协议单独发布在 [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ethanyoq/dsh-ai-novel-writer)，安装与使用见[插件说明](plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer/README.md)。 ## 许可证 桌面应用以 [GPL-3.0](LICENSE) 协议开源。

Pagekin

Formerly “AI Novel Writer” (AI 小说作家). Chinese name: 书童, “the scholar’s page”.

Pagekin, free AI novel writing software
Go from setup, story architecture, and chapter blueprints to drafting, review, revision, and final chapters, one chapter at a time. You can also break down a reference novel to imitate its style, import your manuscript and continue it, or rewrite to your own instructions.
Local-first: your books stay on your own computer. No model is bundled: use your own API key, or run a local model with Ollama.

Pagekin is maintained by EthanYoQ. The [official website](https://www.orz.md/en/ai-novel-writer/) provides the product overview, setup guide and official download links.


English first-use guide with real screenshots
Manual project setup. Bring your own local or cloud model.

> ## What's new in 1.3.0 > > - The whole interface is now the new Paper and Ink writing interface, organized as setup, architecture, blueprint, and manuscript. > - A chapter goes from unwritten to final on one page: drafting, review, revision, merging, and finalization. > - The blueprint page's "Write chapter N" opens a small popover instead of a large form. > - Every generation run is shown in one run sheet, where you can cancel, pause a batch, or confirm continuation. > - Appearance offers light and dark only. The assistant chat entry is hidden for now and will return separately. > > See the [1.3.0 release notes](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/Pagekin/releases/tag/v1.3.0) for details. ## What it does Pagekin works in the order a novel gets written: you are the author, it is your page. Each step is saved in the book and feeds the next one. AI drafts, and you confirm every step. ### Library: all your books in one place The library lists every book you have written. Select a cover to preview it: the current step, word count, final chapters, and characters. You can start a new book or import a copy of a project from an older version. ![Library with two books on the shelf and the preview and progress of "Lighthouse" on the right](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-library.webp) ### Breakdown, imitation, continuation, and rewriting "Novel breakdown & imitation" in the library imports a novel as a .txt, .md, or .epub file, splits it into chapters, and asks what the text is for. - **Breakdown and imitation**: choose "Reference novel". AI breaks down its structure, extracts its style, infers chapter blueprints, and produces imitation constraints for your later writing. A reference novel goes only into the knowledge base and the breakdown; it never mixes into your prose. - **Continue your manuscript**: choose "My manuscript". The chapters you already wrote are imported by chapter number as finalized text, and AI continues the following chapters from those characters and events. - **Continue a passage**: select text in the prose editor and choose Continue on the toolbar; AI writes on from that passage. - **Rewrite**: to rewrite a whole chapter, use Revise. Write the direction you want, optionally check review notes, and compare the result with the original paragraph by paragraph to choose which version to keep. For a short passage, select it and use Refine, Expand, or To dialogue on the toolbar. ### Setup and architecture: build the story first The setup page records the genre, audience, writing language, total chapters, and words per chapter. The architecture page has four sections: premise, cast, worldbuilding, and plot outline. AI can generate each section, or you can write it yourself. When all four are confirmed, move on to chapter blueprints. ![Architecture page with the premise, cast, worldbuilding, and plot outline all confirmed](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-architecture.webp) The cast is edited alongside the architecture. Each character has a profile, a current state, and a relationship graph. You can paste character cards or import them from a file. ![Cast page with four characters on the left and the profile of the protagonist Mara Lind on the right](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-cast.webp) ### Chapter blueprints: plan each chapter before writing The blueprint page plans the book chapter by chapter. Each chapter states the protagonist's goal, the conflict and turn, the suspense hook, and the characters who appear. AI can generate blueprints in chapter ranges, and an interrupted run can continue. The main button is "Write chapter N". The small popover next to it holds only the options for this run: which model to use and an optional line of author guidance. To write several chapters in a row, use "Batch write", up to 10 chapters at a time. ![Blueprint page with chapter 3 "The Fog Bell" selected and the options popover for "Write chapter 3" open](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-blueprint.webp) ### Manuscript: draft, review, revise, finalize The single-chapter view takes a chapter from unwritten to final. After AI writes a draft, you can edit it yourself or ask AI to review it. The review report lists each note. You check or ignore each one, and you can add your own. The revision comes back as a diff that you confirm paragraph by paragraph, so nothing is overwritten. When it reads right, finalize the chapter. ![Single-chapter view: the setup, architecture, blueprint, and manuscript steps on the left, chapter 3 prose in the middle, and the review report on the right](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-chapter.webp) While writing, AI receives this chapter's blueprint, the related characters, the worldbuilding, summaries of earlier chapters, and the full previous chapter, not a chat transcript of the whole book. In the prose editor, Tab inserts two full-width spaces as a paragraph indent. A whole chapter can be written with the keyboard alone. ### Run sheet: see what AI is doing Every generation run appears in the run sheet, with In progress, History, and Diagnostics tabs. You can watch the output as it is written and cancel at any time. A batch can be paused. If a run fails, the text written so far is kept as a recovery candidate that you can copy or discard. ![Run sheet writing chapter 3 with live output appearing sentence by sentence](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-run.webp) ### References and versions: keep track of a long book - **Plot & threads**: follow the main plot, subplots, and foreshadowing chapter by chapter, and record where each thread is planted, advanced, or resolved. - **Knowledge base**: import reference material (.txt, .md). Local full-text search works even without a retrieval model. - **Version history**: every past version of a chapter is kept. Compare it with the current draft, or restore it as a new draft. - **Export and backup**: export as merged Markdown, one Markdown file per chapter, or plain text. Archive a book on your computer or back it up to a WebDAV cloud you connect. Restoring always creates a new copy. ### Writing skills: bring your own writing rules On the "Writing skills" settings page, choose a local skill folder or a single SKILL.md, or enter the address of a skill on GitHub, to import a prompt-only writing skill, such as one that removes the typical AI tone, or one for a particular style or genre. Reference text files that SKILL.md cites are included. The app reads the skill and shows you its content before you install it. Bind it to the planning, drafting, review, or revision stage, and every generation in that stage includes it. Only self-contained SKILL.md prompts are supported. Scripts, hooks, subagents, and tool requirements are not installed, so a skill cannot run code on your computer. ### Dark theme and two interface languages Appearance offers light and dark. The interface is available in Chinese and English. A book's writing language can be Chinese or English. ![Single-chapter view in the dark theme](docs/assets/readme/v130-en-chapter-dark.webp) ## Supported models and services Pagekin does not provide models or host quotas. In settings, enter your own service address, model name, and API key. Two request protocols are supported: - **OpenAI-compatible**: any service compatible with the Chat Completions API. - **Native Gemini**: Google Gemini. Settings include presets for these providers: | Provider | Protocol | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | DeepSeek | OpenAI-compatible | Preset address `https://api.deepseek.com` | | SiliconFlow | OpenAI-compatible | Preset address `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1` | | BigModel (Zhipu) | OpenAI-compatible | Preset address `https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/paas/v4` | | OpenAI | OpenAI-compatible | Preset address `https://api.openai.com` | | xAI (Grok) | OpenAI-compatible | Preset address `https://api.x.ai/v1` | | Google Gemini | Native Gemini | Preset address `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` | | Ollama (local) | OpenAI-compatible | The model runs on your own computer | | NovelAI | OpenAI-compatible | Minimal compatibility, not fully verified with a real account | | Custom | OpenAI-compatible | Any compatible service address | "Custom" only changes the address, model name, and credentials within the two protocols above. It is not an arbitrary HTTP interface. Anthropic, Azure, native KoboldAI, and similar interfaces need dedicated adapters, and a URL swap does not make them work. Semantic search in the knowledge base needs a separate embedding model, configured under "Retrieval model" in settings. ### Run a local model with Ollama ```text Provider: Ollama (local) or Custom Protocol: OpenAI-compatible Base URL: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 API key: may be left blank; if the UI requires one, use any placeholder Model: your Ollama model name, for example qwen3:14b ``` Embedding models also use the `/v1` address. Do not use `http://127.0.0.1:11434/api`, which is Ollama's native interface. ## Download and install Download official installers only from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/EthanYoQ/Pagekin/releases/latest). ### Windows x64 ```text ai-novel-writer-setup-.exe ``` 1. Run the installer. An upgrade updates only the application and does not delete books, character cards, or settings. Back up important work first anyway. 2. After installation, check for updates under "Settings → About & updates". A new version is announced first. It downloads only after you choose "Download update", and when it finishes you choose to restart now or later. 3. Older portable ZIP builds cannot get the updater automatically. Install an official installer manually once. The installer is not code-signed at present. Windows may show an unknown-publisher warning. Continue only after confirming that the download page is this repository's official GitHub Release. ### macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) ```text ai-novel-writer-mac-arm64--installer.dmg ai-novel-writer-mac-x64--installer.dmg ``` 1. `arm64` is for Apple Silicon Macs (M1, M2, M3, M4, and later). `x64` is for Intel Macs. 2. Drag the app from the DMG to Applications and launch it. The app announces new versions but does not download or replace itself on macOS. Updating opens the official Release page so you can download the installer for your architecture. 3. Both installers are ad-hoc signed, have no Developer ID signature, and are not notarized. If Gatekeeper blocks the app, confirm that it came from this repository's official GitHub Release, then Control-click the app in Finder and choose "Open", or allow it in "System Settings → Privacy & Security". ## Data and privacy | Data or behavior | Location or destination | | --- | --- | | Books, characters, blueprints, drafts, and final chapters | Your book folder and a local SQLite database. | | Recovery candidates from failed runs | Only in the current book's local database. They never become drafts or final chapters on their own. | | Imported reference material | Stays in the local book unless you send it to a cloud model. | | Local model requests | Sent to the local or LAN inference service you configure. | | Cloud model requests | Prompts and context go to the provider you choose. | | Model settings and API keys | Stored in the `ai-novel-writer` folder of your app data directory (`%APPDATA%\ai-novel-writer` on Windows, `~/Library/Application Support/ai-novel-writer` on macOS). Protect your OS account and do not share this folder. | | App preferences | Stored in the same folder as the model settings. | Earlier versions kept settings in `~/.vela`. The current version copies them to the folder above at startup and leaves the original untouched. The app does not provide model accounts, cloud generation, or promotional messages. Update checks read public GitHub Releases only. ## FAQ **Is Pagekin free?** Yes. It is open source under the GPL-3.0 license. Any cost of calling a cloud model is between you and the model provider. A local model through Ollama needs no provider at all. **Which models do I need?** Any model behind an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API works, and Google Gemini uses its native protocol. Settings include presets for DeepSeek, SiliconFlow, Zhipu, OpenAI, xAI, Gemini, Ollama, and NovelAI. Output quality depends on the model you choose. The app makes no promise about model output. **Where is my data stored?** On your own computer: the book folder plus a local SQLite database. The relevant prompts, story setup, and context are sent to your configured model service only when you start a generation. **How long can a novel be?** You set the total number of chapters, with no fixed limit. For each chapter, AI receives the chapter's blueprint, the related characters, the worldbuilding, summaries of earlier chapters, and the full previous chapter, so the whole book never has to fit in one conversation. Batch write handles up to 10 chapters per run, and you can keep going run after run. **Does it support writing in English?** Yes. The interface is available in Chinese and English, and each book's writing language can be Chinese or English. **How do I upgrade projects from an older version to 1.3.0?** If you have 1.1.0 or 1.2.x installed, upgrade through the in-app updater (on macOS, download the new installer by hand). Upgrading leaves your books unchanged and migrates the old appearance preference to light or dark. To convert an older project to the new format, choose "Import" in the library and then "Import an old project copy". Importing creates a new copy and leaves the original project untouched. **Can I import skills, such as one that removes the AI tone?** Yes. On the "Writing skills" settings page, choose a local skill folder or SKILL.md, or enter the skill's GitHub address, review its content, install it, and bind it to a stage such as drafting or revision. Only prompt-only SKILL.md files are supported; no scripts are installed or run. **Where did the assistant chat go?** The new 1.3.0 interface hides the assistant chat entry for now. It will return separately. Drafting, review, revision, and the rest of the workflow are unaffected. **Windows or macOS says the installer is unsafe. What should I do?** The Windows installer is unsigned, and the Mac installers are only ad-hoc signed and not notarized by Apple, so the system warns you. After confirming the installer came from this repository's official GitHub Release, follow the steps under "Download and install" to allow it. ## Current limits - A URL and key alone do not guarantee that any third-party API works. Only the implemented protocols and presets are supported. - The app does not replace your creative judgment, fact checking, or copyright decisions. Review everything AI writes. - It does not offer online publishing, a reading community, or cloud model accounts. ## Build from source You need Node.js 22.14 or later and the pnpm version pinned in the repository. ```sh git clone https://github.com/EthanYoQ/AI-Novel-Writer.git cd AI-Novel-Writer pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm dev ``` Official installers are built in GitHub Actions. The Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, and macOS Intel installers each pass their own qualification before they are listed in one GitHub Release.
